memory_candidates.content: When a non-quote-aware separator split (;/&/|) is used inside a classifier, the direction its parsing errors push matters: if an error pushes toward the classifier's SAFE verdict, an unaware split is an accepted blind spot (e.g. detect-noop-bash.sh's original is_trivial_command, where an error pushes toward 'not trivial'). But if a NEW classifier's error would push toward the UNSAFE verdict for its own purpose (e.g. a repeated-inspection-probe detector where a mis-split falsely breaks the shape match and causes an unwanted reset), quoted spans must be blanked first via the sed -z 's/"[^"]*"/""/g' -e "s/'[^']*'/''/g" idiom (already used by guard-destructive-git.sh) before splitting on separators.

To build a measured (not synthetic) regression fixture for a hook or detector, extract real Bash tool-use commands directly from a Claude Code subagent's own sidechain transcript (a .jsonl file under ~/.claude/projects/<repo>/<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl; each line's message.content[] entries with type=='tool_use' and name=='Bash' carry the raw command in .input.command). This gives a provably real incident sequence to replay through both the pre-change and post-change version of the code under test, rather than inventing a plausible-looking synthetic one.

A verify-deploy.sh FAIL (or doc-lint 'content differs from source') immediately after editing agent-system/extensions/** is frequently expected deploy-tree staleness, not a regression: context/patterns/regeneration-is-manual-only.md documents that .claude/ is a gitignored, pull-only deploy tree that never auto-syncs from the source store, and names exactly two sanctioned automated callers of deploy-headless.sh (command-gate-out.sh's rc==6 branch, orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint). A dispatched implementation agent mid-task is not one of them, so it should NOT self-remediate by invoking deploy-headless.sh -- instead, diagnose each finding against the task's own declared file_scope and concurrent-sibling territory before concluding it's a real regression, and record a Reasoned Exclusion if it is not.
